name: ender-hybrid
note: Ender 3 clone body, 235x235x450, printed Orbiter clone direct drive, V6 0.4 brass nozzle with a 40 W heater, OG Ender 3 V2 bed, dual rails except Y, dual Z on a Mega + RAMPS, Ender 5 Pro board, Pi 3B, Klipper, BMCU.
